book.name: Luk
book.title: To Nafa We Luk E Sa꞉sa꞉lo꞉

content: Asugo꞉ mo꞉nodolalega soma꞉ib

Kalu kegeo꞉ nolba꞉yo꞉ Ya꞉sumo꞉wo꞉ to nolo꞉ malolo꞉ meaki, Ga꞉lili kalu noldo꞉ amilo꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉ a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ malolo꞉. Ga꞉lili kalu i a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ no꞉ sa꞉ndaki, Godemo꞉wo꞉ boba so꞉meabikiyo꞉, Failat eyo꞉ kalu i a꞉no꞉ sana soma꞉ki sio꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ iyo꞉ sana sowa꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, ho꞉bo꞉ ililo꞉ o꞉lia꞉ no꞉ ho꞉bo꞉ o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ ua gasalifa꞉.

Ya꞉suwo꞉ malolo꞉ a꞉no꞉ da꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, imo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ga꞉lili kalu ko꞉lo꞉ sana sowo꞉ a꞉ma꞉ mogago꞉ ililo꞉ dimida꞉len a꞉ma꞉yo꞉, Ga꞉lili kalu nolba꞉lo꞉ mogago꞉ dimida꞉lab a꞉no꞉ ili tiniabiki dimido꞉ a꞉la꞉asulaya?
A꞉la꞉baka꞉! Ko꞉sega mogago꞉ gililo꞉ dimida꞉len a꞉no꞉ ta꞉ta꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Godelo꞉loba꞉da꞉yo꞉ mo꞉nodolalega, gio꞉lo꞉ a꞉la꞉soma꞉ib.

A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Ya꞉lusalem amisa꞉n amilo꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉ a꞉no꞉ gio꞉ dabu. Siloam hen a꞉namio꞉ a iwalulo꞉ nowo꞉ dugu alilaki, kalu do꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ola꞉fo꞉wo꞉ a꞉na sowo꞉. Kalu sowo꞉ a꞉ma꞉ mogago꞉ ililo꞉ dimida꞉len a꞉ma꞉yo꞉, Ya꞉lusalem kalu nolba꞉lo꞉ mogago꞉ dimida꞉lab a꞉no꞉ ili tiniabiki dimido꞉ a꞉la꞉asulaya?
A꞉la꞉ba! Niyo꞉ wa꞉ka a꞉so꞉lo꞉l. Mogago꞉ gililo꞉ dimido꞉ a꞉no꞉ ta꞉ta꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Godelo꞉loba꞉da꞉yo꞉ mo꞉nodolalega, gio꞉lo꞉ tambo a꞉la꞉soma꞉ib.”
I fowo꞉ mo꞉hedo꞉wa bale sio꞉
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Ya꞉su eyo꞉ bale sio꞉ we imo꞉ malolo꞉ me. “Kalu noma꞉yo꞉ ene egelo꞉ amio꞉, alona꞉ iyo꞉ a꞉lab ko꞉lo꞉, ho꞉len no amio꞉ e alona꞉ fowo꞉ tuma꞉ni ane ko꞉sega fo imilise nowo꞉ mo꞉ba꞉ba꞉.

A꞉la꞉go꞉ko꞉lo꞉ eyo꞉ ene egelo꞉lo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉len kalumo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, ‘Dona otalen us a꞉namio꞉, i we fowo꞉ hedo꞉wa꞉le a꞉la꞉li ba꞉ba꞉ ya꞉len ko꞉sega, i a꞉no꞉ fowo꞉ mada mo꞉hedo꞉ ba꞉ba꞉. I a꞉no꞉ ba madali ka iliki heno꞉ a꞉ma꞉ walab ko꞉lo꞉, giyo꞉ kunuma.’
A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, egelo꞉lo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉len kalu eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, ‘Kalu Alan, dona imilise nowo꞉ i we ka o꞉ta꞉takiyo꞉, niyo꞉ i mo꞉ a꞉namio꞉ heno꞉ daida꞉sa꞉ga꞉, bea꞉susugo꞉ a꞉na to꞉loma꞉no꞉.
Dona hononamio꞉ fowo꞉ hedalega, a꞉no꞉ nafa ko꞉m. Fowo꞉ mo꞉hedalega, gio꞉ a꞉na kunuma a꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉bi.’”
Ya꞉su eyo꞉ ga nowo꞉ falele alifa꞉

Ha꞉fo꞉lo꞉ Dowan ho꞉len no amio꞉, Ya꞉su eyo꞉ tolo꞉ wida꞉sen a a꞉namio꞉ kaluka꞉isalemo꞉ widakiyo꞉, ga imilise nowo꞉ a꞉na elen. Ga a꞉no꞉ donayo꞉ do꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ola꞉fo꞉ a꞉namio꞉ mama mogago꞉wo꞉ eya ilikiyo꞉, fa꞉so꞉ kogo꞉ dowaki, mo꞉digale kagama꞉no꞉ dowa꞉sen.
Ya꞉su eyo꞉ ga a꞉no꞉ ba꞉da꞉ga꞉yo꞉, elo꞉wa mena꞉ki ho꞉ida꞉sa꞉ga꞉, emo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ga, ge amilo꞉ walaf ba꞉la꞉len a꞉no꞉ o꞉go꞉ ge ga꞉li dowab.”
A꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉sa꞉ga꞉ ene dagiyo꞉ ga a꞉ma꞉ do꞉mo꞉wa golabiki, ga a꞉no꞉ digale kagayakiyo꞉, Godeya꞉ wiyo꞉ a꞉na wabulu sio꞉.

Tolo꞉ wida꞉sen alo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉lowan misa꞉ kalu eyo꞉ Ha꞉fo꞉lo꞉ Dowan ho꞉len a꞉namilo꞉ Ya꞉suwa꞉lo꞉ falele alitab a꞉no꞉ ba꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, e mo꞉beaki kaluka꞉isalemo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ho꞉len do꞉go꞉fela꞉fo꞉ a꞉namio꞉ nanog dia꞉no꞉wo꞉ a꞉na doma꞉ib ko꞉lo꞉ gio꞉ falele alifoma꞉kiyo꞉ ho꞉len a꞉na ya꞉bi. Ko꞉sega Ha꞉fo꞉lo꞉ Dowan ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉ falelema꞉kiyo꞉ ya꞉so꞉bo.”

A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, Kalu Alan eyo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉yo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “To gililo꞉ sa꞉lab a꞉no꞉, gililo꞉ dimida꞉sen a꞉no꞉lia꞉yo꞉ mo꞉imilab! Ha꞉fo꞉lo꞉ Dowan ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉ giliyo꞉ donki ayamilo꞉ galo alifelo꞉ a꞉no꞉ ho꞉no꞉ maiya꞉kiyo꞉, fage alifa꞉la꞉sa꞉ga꞉, ha꞉la꞉ya tililia꞉ ha꞉na꞉sen.
Ga we Ablahama꞉ eso꞉lo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, Sa꞉da꞉na꞉ eyo꞉ donayo꞉ do꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ola꞉fo꞉ us a꞉namio꞉ mele alitaki ta꞉fo꞉len. A꞉la꞉go꞉ko꞉lo꞉ Ha꞉fo꞉lo꞉ Dowan ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉ e o꞉li fage alifa꞉iba꞉le?”
Ya꞉su eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉labikiyo꞉, kalu e o꞉lia꞉lo꞉ kega꞉sen i a꞉no꞉ sendelowo꞉. Ko꞉sega kaluka꞉isale iyo꞉ elo꞉ man nafale dimida꞉len a꞉no꞉ ba꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, sagalo꞉wo꞉ alan dowa꞉sen.
Mased fowa bale sio꞉
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Ya꞉su eyo꞉ widakiyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Godeya꞉lo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉mela꞉no꞉ man a꞉no꞉ o꞉bo꞉ngo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ da꞉laba? Niyo꞉ a꞉no꞉ gimo꞉wo꞉ waga walama꞉no꞉wa꞉le?
Godeya꞉lo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉mela꞉no꞉ a꞉no꞉ mased
fo fifo꞉ amilo꞉ fa꞉la꞉ndab o꞉ngo꞉ dowab. Kaluwa꞉yo꞉ fo ha꞉lula꞉su a꞉no꞉ egelo꞉wa fifo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, alan fa꞉la꞉ndaki eleyo꞉ tagalakiyo꞉, o꞉ba꞉ iliyo꞉ ayo꞉ so꞉go꞉f a꞉na dia꞉sen.”
Falawa anayan kelego꞉ a꞉na bale sio꞉
Ya꞉su eyo꞉ to nolo꞉ a꞉widakiyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Godeya꞉lo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉mela꞉no꞉ man a꞉no꞉ o꞉bo꞉ngo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ da꞉laba? Niyo꞉ a꞉no꞉ gimo꞉wo꞉ waga walama꞉no꞉wa꞉le?
A꞉no꞉ falawa anayan kelego꞉ yis o꞉ngo꞉ dowo꞉. Ga noma꞉yo꞉ yis ha꞉lu a꞉no꞉ falawa wo꞉fa꞉ otalen a꞉no꞉lia꞉ wo꞉gele alitalikiyo꞉, yis a꞉no꞉ mo꞉ba꞉ba꞉ib ko꞉sega falawa a꞉no꞉ tambo anama꞉ib.”
Tog ha꞉luwa hamana
Ya꞉su e Ya꞉lusalem ha꞉na꞉ni ha꞉nakiyo꞉, eyo꞉ amisa꞉n alan o꞉lia꞉ ha꞉lu o꞉lia꞉ a꞉na wida꞉li ane.
E ha꞉nabikiyo꞉, kalu noma꞉yo꞉ emo꞉ dabu ba꞉daki, “Kalu Alan, Gode eyo꞉ kaluka꞉isaleyo꞉ a꞉la꞉se ko꞉ gasilia꞉iba?”

Ya꞉su eyo꞉ imo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Niyo꞉ gimo꞉wo꞉ hendele so꞉lo꞉l. Kaluka꞉isale modo꞉wo꞉ Hebene usamio꞉ tina꞉no꞉ a꞉la꞉asula꞉li ane ko꞉sega midima꞉ib. A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ gio꞉ tog ha꞉lu a꞉na tina꞉nikiyo꞉, nanogo꞉ halaido꞉ dimida꞉lubi.

Alo꞉ biso꞉wa꞉yo꞉ togo꞉ uludu alitalikiyo꞉, ge ha꞉la꞉ya kagafo꞉liki toga godogodolalikiyo꞉, gio꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉ma꞉ib, ‘Nio꞉lo꞉ a usa mia꞉niki togo꞉ kolama.’ Ko꞉sega eyo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉bo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉ma꞉ib, ‘Ne gio꞉ mo꞉asulo꞉. Gilo꞉ mio꞉wo꞉ ne babalab.’
Eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, giliyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉ma꞉ib, ‘Nio꞉ ge o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ na꞉sen a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉, giyo꞉ to mano꞉ nili amisa꞉n amio꞉ wida꞉sen.’
Ko꞉sega eyo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉bo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉ma꞉ib, ‘Ne gio꞉ mo꞉asulo꞉ a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ gilo꞉ mio꞉wo꞉ ne babalab ko꞉lo꞉, mogago꞉lo꞉ dimida꞉sen kalu gio꞉ tambo hamana!’

Tif amio꞉ gio꞉ Ablahamo꞉, Aisa꞉go꞉, Ya꞉kobo꞉, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ dinali sa꞉lan kaluwo꞉ Godeya꞉lo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉mela꞉no꞉ hen a꞉na sena ba꞉ba꞉ib. Ko꞉sega Gode eyo꞉ gio꞉ ha꞉la꞉ya sandifa꞉ib ko꞉lo꞉ gio꞉ kulufa꞉yakiyo꞉, ya꞉foda꞉li mela꞉ib.
Kaluka꞉isale ofdo꞉ yan doba꞉da꞉yo꞉lo꞉, ofdo꞉ tinan doba꞉da꞉yo꞉lo꞉, henfelo꞉ we tambo amilo꞉ mio꞉ a꞉no꞉ Godeya꞉lo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉mela꞉no꞉ hen us a꞉na ua kegeaki, sagalo꞉ ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ a꞉na ma꞉ib.
Gio꞉ to we asuluma. O꞉gdo꞉ kalu wa꞉feyo꞉ a꞉lab a꞉no꞉, ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉ e wabulun kalu doma꞉ib. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ kalu o꞉gdo꞉ wilo꞉ a꞉lab a꞉no꞉, ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉ e tifa doma꞉ib.”
Ya꞉su eyo꞉ Ya꞉lusalemo꞉ alan nofolo꞉
O꞉g ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉, Fa꞉lisi kalu nolo꞉ Ya꞉sulo꞉wa ya꞉sa꞉ga꞉, emo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Misa꞉ kalu Ha꞉lod eyo꞉ ge sana sa꞉ma꞉no꞉ asulab ko꞉lo꞉, ge hen we ta꞉ta꞉ga꞉ nowa hamana.”

A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki Ya꞉su eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ha꞉lod e saila gasa o꞉ngo꞉ dowo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ to we emo꞉wo꞉ sa꞉ma꞉ni hamana, ‘O꞉go꞉ niyo꞉ mama mogago꞉wo꞉ o꞉lusa꞉ndaki, walaf kaluwo꞉ falele alifelema꞉no꞉. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ aliyo꞉ niyo꞉ wa꞉ka a꞉dimida꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, ho꞉len asol a꞉namio꞉, niyo꞉ nanog we dia꞉la꞉ga꞉ a꞉na elema꞉no꞉.’ To a꞉no꞉ Ha꞉lodbo꞉wo꞉ sa꞉la꞉bi.

Ya꞉lusalem amisa꞉n a꞉no꞉ dinali sa꞉lan kalulo꞉ sana sowan heno꞉ o꞉m. Hendele o꞉go꞉, aliyo꞉, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ inaliyo꞉, ne ka ha꞉na꞉ga꞉ ha꞉na꞉no꞉. Mo꞉wo꞉ dinali sa꞉lan kaluwo꞉ hen nowa sana sowalikiyo꞉ mo꞉lilo꞉. Tambo Ya꞉lusalem a꞉naka sana sowa꞉len.

“Wai Ya꞉lusalem Ya꞉lusalem. Gio꞉ dinali sa꞉lan kaluwo꞉ sana sowa꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Godeya꞉ tolo꞉ dia꞉ya꞉lab kaluwo꞉ uwa꞉ agoda꞉sa꞉ga꞉ sana sowa꞉sen. Gogonowa꞉lo꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ ene a꞉fula꞉ ha꞉g amilo꞉ kegenelia꞉ga꞉ tili dowan o꞉leaumbo꞉, niyo꞉ Ya꞉lusalem kaluka꞉isale gio꞉ a꞉la꞉kegenelia꞉ga꞉ tili doma꞉no꞉ a꞉la꞉ asula꞉lo꞉l ko꞉sega, gio꞉ nemo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉dimidama꞉kiyo꞉ mo꞉asulab.

Dabuma! Gode e gi amisa꞉no꞉ ta꞉fo꞉gane ko꞉lo꞉ mogago꞉ a꞉lab. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ gio꞉ ne misio꞉ wa꞉kabiyo꞉ mo꞉ba꞉ba꞉ib. Ko꞉sega giliyo꞉ towo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉lalikiyo꞉, ‘Kalu we, Gode Alana꞉ wiya a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ mio꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, niliyo꞉ sagala꞉liki, Godemo꞉ mada o꞉m a꞉la꞉so꞉lo꞉l’ to a꞉no꞉ sa꞉lalikiyo꞉, ho꞉len a꞉nami o꞉isa, ne wa꞉ka ba꞉ba꞉ib.” Ya꞉su eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉.

footnotes.text: 13.19 Mased a꞉la꞉do꞉ sa꞉lab a꞉no꞉, Yu kaluwa꞉lo꞉ i fo gela꞉seno꞉ o꞉m. Fo a꞉no꞉ mada ha꞉lula꞉su ko꞉sega fa꞉la꞉ndab amio꞉, alan doma꞉ib.
